name: Resource Scarcity
description: Limited availability of key inputs forces prioritisation and trade-offs.

name: Hidden Information
description: Players act without full knowledge, requiring inference and risk management.

name: Action Economy
description: Each participant has a limited number of actions per cycle or turn.

name: Push Your Luck
description: Risk-reward structure where greater gains increase probability of failure.

name: Drafting
description: Participants select from shared pools of options sequentially.

name: Role Specialisation
description: Different participants have asymmetric abilities or responsibilities.

name: Time Pressure
description: Decisions must be made within strict temporal constraints.
